summary: Emotional needs press against power and transformation. This frictional pattern asks you to use emotional intelligence and depth with awareness.
body: Emotional needs press against power and transformation. This frictional pattern asks you to use emotional intelligence and depth with awareness. Emotional power struggles, jealousy, and compulsion. The friction makes the pattern noticeable, especially when pressure forces an adjustment. In practice, this can show up through emotional needs, power and transformation, and the choices you make when mood-driven reaction or control starts running the room.
gift: The gift is emotional intelligence, depth, and a more conscious way to work with emotional needs and power and transformation.
shadow: The shadow is mood-driven reaction, control, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let emotional needs and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Emotional intensity: depth is an asset, volatility a liability.
do: Name how emotional needs and power and transformation are both involved
Pause before choosing the most familiar reaction
Turn emotional intelligence and depth into one concrete choice
dont: Let mood-driven reaction make the decision
Treat tension as proof that something is wrong
Ignore the needs of emotional needs or power and transformation
